attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent run.** Columns 0 to 12, `tnaC` to `yidA`, are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and 0 to 11% of calls are in a region of plasticity. The model names 88 to 99.6% of genes there, fewest at `mnmE`, 88%, and hesitates most at `dnaA`, 0.89 bits.

**Then the `dgo` genes**, columns 14 to 17, spine, carried by 90 to 93% of chromosomes, all shell, and 91 to 92% of calls are in a region of plasticity, the most plastic stretch of the window. The model names 91 to 99% of them, fewest at `dgoR`, 91%, and hesitates 0.20 bits at most, at `dgoD`.

**A persistent stretch follows**, columns 19 to 24, `cbrA` to `yidE`, carried by 98 to 99.6% of chromosomes, all persistent, 3 to 27% of calls in a region of plasticity. The model names 36 to 99% of genes, fewest at `ibpB`, 36%, and no column there hesitates more than 0.18 bits. Columns 25 to 30 are fork and variable columns, 43 to 81% of calls in a region of plasticity, named 83 to 97%, fewest and most hesitant at column 27, 83%, 0.71 bits.

**Columns 31 to 35 are spine**, `yidH` to `ysdE`, carried by 97 to 99.6% of chromosomes, all persistent, 1 to 13% of calls in a region of plasticity, named 96 to 99%. Then columns 37 to 50, `ivbL` to `yicL`, spine, 95 to 99% of chromosomes, all persistent, 0.4 to 31% of calls in a region of plasticity, named 85 to 98%, fewest and most hesitant at `yicL`, 85%, 0.84 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns**, 51 to 79, 28 to 59% of calls in a region of plasticity, named 75 to 89%, fewest at column 79, 75%. The model hesitates most at column 52, `yicJ`, 1.38 bits, 57% in a region of plasticity. A second branch of 7 families runs through columns 53 to 59, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, carried by 15 to 16%, all shell. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.97 against 0.22 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 95%.

label: tnaC
facts:
WINDOW: the tnaC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor tnaC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,418 to 4,497 from dnaA. Read in 528 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying tnaC once); 41,712 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.44 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,689 calls, named 96%, 0.18 bits; shell 13,299 calls, named 80%, 0.83 bits; cloud 724 calls, named 18%, 3.38 bits. Outside an RGP 29,698 calls, named 95%, 0.22 bits; inside an RGP 12,014 calls, named 78%, 0.97 bits. Columns: 42 spine, 17 fork, 21 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.97 against 0.22 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 95%); 12,014 of the 41,712 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 52 (yicJ) 1.38 bits, RGP 57%; column 51 (setC) 1.07 bits, RGP 51%; column 53 (yicI) 1.06 bits, RGP 59%. The 18 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.55 bits on average; the other 62 columns: named 90%, 0.41 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 14-17 (spine), RGP 91-92%; the least: column 36 (variable), RGP 1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-12 (13 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-11%. Genes: tnaC, mnmE, yidC "membrane protein insertase YidC", yidD "membrane protein insertion efficien…", rnpA, rpmH, "protein YsdD", dnaA "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…", dnaN, recF, gyrB, yidB "YidB family protein", yidA "Cof-type HAD-IIB family hydrolase". named 88-99.6% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 1 (mnmE), named 88%; most hesitant at column 7 (dnaA), 0.89 bits.
2. column 13 fork: RGP 83%. named 81%; 0.13 bits.
   13: yidX S 71% "protein YidX"; also "hypothetical protein" S 27%
3. columns 14-17 (4 columns) spine: share 90-93%, all S, RGP 91-92%. Genes: dgoR, dgoK, dgoA "2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phosphogalacton…", dgoD. named 91-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 14 (dgoR), named 91%; most hesitant at column 17 (dgoD), 0.20 bits.
4. column 18 variable: RGP 75%. named 95%; 0.40 bits.
   18: dgoT S 89%
5. columns 19-24 (6 columns) spine: share 98-99.6%, all P, RGP 3-27%. Genes: cbrA, yidR, yidQ "YceK/YidQ family lipoprotein", ibpA "small heat shock chaperone IbpA", ibpB, yidE. named 36-99% (mean 82%), fewest named at column 23 (ibpB), named 36%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.18 bits (column 19 (cbrA)).
6. columns 25-30 (6 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 43-81%. named 83-97% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 27, named 83%, 0.71 bits.
   25 variable: yidP S 78% "GntR family transcriptional regulat…"
   26 variable: glvC S 83%
   27 fork: yidL S 79% "helix-turn-helix transcriptional re…"; also glvA S 47%
   28 fork: yidK S 76% "solute:sodium symporter family tran…"; also insQ S 15%
   29 variable: yidJ S 77% "sulfatase-like hydrolase/transferase"
   30 variable: yidI S 66% "protein YidI"
7. columns 31-35 (5 columns) spine: share 97-99.6%, all P, RGP 1-13%. Genes: yidH "YidH family protein", yidG "DUF202 domain-containing protein", yidF "radical SAM protein", emrD, ysdE. named 96-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 32 (yidG), named 96%, 0.23 bits.
8. column 36 variable: RGP 1%. named 91%; 0.30 bits.
   36: tisB S 88%
9. columns 37-50 (14 columns) spine: share 95-99%, all P, RGP 0.4-31%. Genes: ivbL, ilvB "acetolactate synthase large subunit", ilvN, uhpA, uhpB "signal transduction histidine-prote…", uhpC, uhpT, adeD "adenine deaminase C-terminal domain…", adeQ, yicN "DUF1198 family protein", nepI, yicS "YicS family protein", nlpA, yicL "EamA family transporter". named 85-98% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 50 (yicL), named 85%, 0.84 bits.
10. columns 51-79 (29 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 28-59%. named 75-89% (mean 84%), fewest named at column 79, named 75%; most hesitant at column 52, 1.38 bits.
   a second branch of 7 families through columns 53-59, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15-16%, all S; the branch's families: "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA", "PTS fructose transporter subunit IIB", "PTS fructose transporter subunit IIC", "class II fructose-bisphosphate aldolase", "class II fructose-bisphosphate aldolase", "ROK family protein", "D-lyxose/D-mannose family sugar isomera…"
   51 fork: setC S 73%; also "helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…" S 26%
   52 fork: yicJ P 83% "glycoside-pentoside-hexuronide (GPH…"; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system RelE/Par…" S 24%, "BglG family transcription antiterminator" S 16%, "hypothetical protein" S 13%
   53 fork: yicI P 81% "alpha-xylosidase"; also "tyrosine-type recombinase/integrase" S 15%, "DUF957 domain-containing protein" S 13%
   54 fork: yicH P 84% "AsmA family protein"; also iatC S 20%
   55 fork: xanP P 82%; also eilA S 20%, cbtA S 12%
   56 fork: gltS P 82%; also "IpaD/SipD/SspD family type III secretio…" S 20%, cbeA S 12%
   57 fork: recG P 80%; also "hypothetical protein" S 12%, "hypothetical protein" S 11%
   58 fork: trmH P 78%; also sctE S 20%, radC S 12%
   59 fork: spoT P 77%; also "hypothetical protein" S 17%
   60 fork: rpoZ P 75%; also "SycD/LcrH family type III secretion sys…" S 20%
   61 fork: gmk P 74%; also "DUF932 domain-containing protein" S 12%
   62 variable: ligB P 68%
   63 variable: yicG P 72% "trimeric intracellular cation chann…"
   64 fork: yicC P 62% "YicC/YloC family endoribonuclease"; also dinD S 57%
   columns 65-69 variable, share 49-60%, all P: rph 60%, pyrE 57%, slmA 54%, dut 50%, coaBC 49%
   70 fork: radC P 47%; also rpmB P 45%
   columns 71-78 variable, share 3-43%, 5 P, 3 S: rpmG 43%, mutM 41%, coaD 38%, waaA 36%, rfaQ 21%, escP 3%, rfaQ 13%, waaG 30%
   79 fork: rfaP P 25%; also waaO S 11%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): dgoR D-galactonate utilization transcription…; dgoK 2-dehydro-3-deoxygalactonokinase; ibpB small heat shock chaperone IbpB; ilvN acetolactate synthase small subunit; uhpC MFS transporter family glucose-6-phosph…; adeQ adenine permease AdeQ; glvA maltose-6'-phosphate glucosidase; insQ RNA-guided endonuclease InsQ/TnpB famil…; eilA winged helix-turn-helix domain-containi…; cbeA type IV toxin-antitoxin system YeeU fam…; sctE YopB/SseC family type III secretion sys…; dinD DNA damage-inducible protein D; rpmB 50S ribosomal protein L28; waaO glycosyltransferase
END: the window ends at column 79, rfaP, in 25% of chromosomes.
